description: Read observed asking rent reductions over the last seven days in one tracked city. These observations do not guarantee current availability.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

limit.description: Maximum price reductions to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25. Results start with the largest dollar cuts.

name: get_price_cuts
title: Read asking rent cuts
